description: The earlier model generation of the paper's replication (TinyLlama / Qwen2.5 / Gemma-2B), as recorded in runs/suite_20261102_phase1_fixed/run.json. To rerun it, copy this file over config/experiment.json. The one configuration of the experiment, read by train_adapters.py, replay.py, tournament.py and eval/evaluate.py. tournament: the evaluated players (every model under each listed condition, and the baseline bots) each play `games` seeded games against two `opponents` bots, rotating seats. models: one entry per player slot (1-3, in order); 'gguf' is the base model the game serves, 'hf'/'dtype'/'batch_size' are for training, 'name' names its artifacts directory. adapters: the adapter set in use, i.e. artifacts/<name>/<name>_<adapters>.gguf for every model; train_adapters.py writes it, replay.py and tournament.py load it in the conditions with lora=true. conditions: the 2 x 4 design, base model or adapter x prompt style of game/player/prompts, named <base|lora>_<prompt>. chat_template: the Jinja chat template llama-server applies (--chat-template-file) and train_adapters.py renders the training prompts with, the model's own template with thinking switched off (Granite and Gemma 4 think by default). llama_cpp: the llama.cpp checkout (llama-server, build-cuda/bin/llama-server for the GPU, convert_lora_to_gguf.py).
